landing.heroSubtitle: The low-code platform that lets you create intelligent, dynamic forms with drag-and-drop simplicity. Collect data, automate workflows, and make better decisions — faster.
landing.featuresDesc: Powerful features that make form building, data collection, and workflow automation effortless.
landing.workflowDesc: A simple, intuitive workflow that takes you from form creation to data collection.
landing.whyDesc: We combine powerful functionality with beautiful design. Here is why teams choose FormFlow.
landing.previewDesc: A glimpse into the polished interfaces that make FormFlow a joy to use.
landing.testimonialsDesc: Hear from the teams that use FormFlow to build better forms and collect smarter data.
landing.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about FormFlow. Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to our team.
landing.ctaDesc: Join thousands of teams using FormFlow to create dynamic forms, automate workflows, and collect smarter data.

builder.title: Dynamic Form Builder
builder.desc: Drag-and-drop interface to create any form imaginable. No code required — just click, drag, and configure.

logic.title: Conditional Logic
logic.desc: Create intelligent forms that adapt to user input. Show, hide, or validate fields based on previous answers.

versioning.title: Version History
versioning.desc: Never lose a change. Track every modification, roll back to any previous version, and collaborate with confidence.

validation.title: Live Validation
validation.desc: Real-time field validation with instant feedback. Custom rules ensure data quality before submission.

fieldTypes.title: Multiple Field Types
fieldTypes.desc: Text, numbers, dates, files, choices, ratings — support for 15+ field types with rich configuration options.

upload.title: File Upload
upload.desc: Secure file uploads with drag-and-drop support. Upload images, PDFs, and documents directly in forms.

downloads.title: Secure Downloads
downloads.desc: Files are stored securely and served with time-limited download links. Your data stays protected at all times.

links.title: Shareable Links
links.desc: Publish your form instantly and share a clean link. Forms render beautifully on desktop, tablet, and mobile.

responses.title: Response Management
responses.desc: View, search, and manage all form responses in a clean dashboard. Export data whenever you need.

dashboard.title: Professional Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Beautiful analytics and management interface. Track form performance, submission trends, and team activity.

performance.title: Fast Performance
performance.desc: Optimized for speed. Forms load instantly, submissions are processed in real-time, and the UI remains snappy.

responsive.title: Responsive Design
responsive.desc: Every form and interface element is fully responsive. Works perfectly across all devices and screen sizes.

testimonials.name: Sarah Chen
testimonials.content: "FormFlow transformed how our team collects client data. The conditional logic is incredibly intuitive — we built complex forms in minutes, not days."

testimonials.name: Marcus Johnson
testimonials.content: "The version history feature is a lifesaver. Being able to roll back changes and track who modified what gives us complete confidence in our forms."

testimonials.name: Priya Patel
testimonials.content: "Finally, a form builder that respects design. The responsive preview, the clean output, and the shareable links make it perfect for our workflow."

testimonials.content: "We evaluated 10+ form builders. FormFlow won because of its API-first architecture and the ability to embed forms seamlessly into our React app."

faqs.a: FormFlow is a low-code dynamic form builder that lets you create, manage, and collect data from forms without writing a single line of code. It features drag-and-drop builder, conditional logic, version history, and much more.
Not at all. FormFlow is designed for everyone — from product managers and designers to developers. The intuitive drag-and-drop interface makes form creation effortless.
Yes! Once you publish a form, you get a unique shareable link that you can send to anyone. Public forms render beautifully on all devices and support file uploads.
Absolutely. FormFlow has a powerful conditional rule engine that lets you show or hide fields based on user responses. You can create complex workflows with visual rule builders.
Yes, you can view all responses in a clean interface and export them whenever you need. All data is stored securely and is available for download.
Yes, FormFlow offers a generous free tier. Create unlimited forms, collect unlimited responses, and access all core features. Upgrade for advanced features.

landing.footerDesc: Build dynamic forms and collect data without writing code. The low-code platform for modern teams.
